host: studio (Apple M3 Ultra, 256 GB), mlx 0.32.2, mlx-lm 0.31.3, mlx-vlm 0.7.1, default Metal kernels
checkpoint: Vontra/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-MLX-4bit-MTP (local copy under oMLX), 4-bit affine group 32, bf16 activations

criteria.no_foreign_multi_token: adapter output must be BIT-IDENTICAL to the same decoder run without the adapter installed, for full prefill and for a multi-token continuation on a cache (same code path, so any difference is an adapter defect)
criteria.hard_off: override=0 with hostile foreign entries must be BIT-IDENTICAL to the no-foreign adapter run, output and every cache array
criteria.single_token_decode: REPORTED, not gated: the public LanguageModel path routes 1-token decode through a batch-invariant forward that bypasses the attention class; the adapter drives the decoder directly. Report max abs difference versus the stock public path and versus the stock decoder path.
criteria.prefill_vs_incremental: REPORTED against the stock model's own prefill-vs-incremental drift measured in the same run; the adapter's drift must not exceed the stock drift by more than 10 percent
criteria.foreign_live: override=1 with foreign entries must change the output; foreign mass per KV layer must lie in [0,1]
criteria.capture: canonical K/V for every KV-bearing layer (12 expected) with shape [T, 2, 256], finite

no_widening: criteria are not changed after the run; a failure is recorded as FAILED with the measured values
